rationale: The selected plan explicitly scopes out scripts/bootstrap.sh (Scope limits: bootstrap clones the coordinator source before any workspace or account selection exists), so adding a second, shell-based named-account credential path to bootstrap and its tests expands the plan's intended behavior rather than completing it; the plan's coverage of coord install/onboard clone creation is already implemented, and private-fork bootstrap belongs in a follow-up issue if the owner wants it.
